row.name: Little Pirates Bilingual Playschool and Daycare, INC.

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: The operation failed to notify Child Care Regulation of an incident in which a child sustained an injury that required medical treatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization: The operation did not complete an incident/illness report form that met all requirements as it was lacking information such as the description of the injury/risk and parent signature.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.701(1))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The operation did not provide a parent with an incident report regarding an incident in which a child sustained an injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: Notification was not provided for the addition to space in the infant room before the change was made.     This was corrected at inspection as Child Care Regulation is now aware of the change that was made.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment: The director was lacking training in the topic of child maltreatment for the most recent completed training year evaluated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1311(c))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two out of six child records evaluated had out of date immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: Three employee records evaluated were lacking training in child maltreatment for the most recent completed training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: Two out of six child records evaluated were lacking a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: The director was lacking training in shaken baby syndrome/abusive head trauma, safe sleep, SIDS, and early childhood brain development for the most recent completed training year evaluated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director was lacking training in the topic of emergency preparedness, building safety, medication administration, food allergies, hazardous materials, etc. for the most recent completed training year evaluated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Three employee records evaluated were lacking training in the required topics of: emergency preparedness, building safety, medication administration, food allergies, hazardous materials, etc. in the most recent completed training year evaluated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Storage for Individual Belongings: The storage/hooks provided for the children's belongings are not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §746.4505)

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The cots used for naptime are not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: A caregiver in charge of the infant room was observed stepping out of the classroom to answer the door leaving 4 infants unsupervised. The caregiver also spent time in the classroom next door instead of returning and remaining in the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: A caregiver in the toddler room did not wash their hands after removing gloves used for diaper changing.    This was corrected at inspection when it was addressed with the caregiver and they washed their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves (26 TAC §746.3505(c))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation failed to submit the number of employees that have left their employment in 2023 by January 15th.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment: Director lacked one hours of prevention, recognition and reporting child maltreatment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1311(c))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger: The operational policies lacked Safe Sleep information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger (26 TAC §746.501(a)(9))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children's product certification has not been re-certified, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: Director lacked training in SIDS, Shken Baby and Understanding early childhood brain development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Two infants did not have infant feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Director did not have training in transportation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The center did not have a current fire inspection.  The last fire inspection was on 8/26/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: One infant was in the crib with a pacifer strap and a bib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The pre k age class had 16 children with the specified age of three years old with one caregiver.   An additional caregiver arrived to make the ratio compliant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies: Three of the four staff files did not include signed statements for receiving operational or personnel policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: A statement of health was missing from one of the four children's files observed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: In the front room, the TV and phone cords were loose and in reach of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: Form 1100 Daily Building and Grounds Checklist had not been filled out since June 20th.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: During the operation's nap time classrooms were combined. The children ranged in age from 15 months to four years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: Loose-fill in landing area for the slide was lacking the necessary 6 inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: The operation lacked a current activity plan for the week of June 13-17, 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: The two year old classroom was watching television while eating lunch.  CI: This was corrected ted at inspection when the caregiver turned the television off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The two year old classroom did not have adequate lighting at nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Groups Not Combined Not Reduced: A group of seven children, with one caregiver with the specified age of 12-18 months were not asleep sitting in high chairs and then moved to classroom. This group of children were over ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Groups Not Combined Not Reduced (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Seven children under the age of two years old were watching television at the beginning of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: Four out of four staff lacked annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification: The driver lacked a staff file with a photo ID.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(8))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: Four out of four staff lacked annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification: The driver lacked a staff file with a photo ID.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(8))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: written daily inspection of playground was not available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: Lighting was not adequate, as I was unable to count how many children were in the mobile infant room due to no lighting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Four out of four staff files lacked an orientation statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Fire drills have not been conducted or documented as required monthly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The pre k classroom was over ratio during  outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Four out of four staff files lacked a personnel record. Staff did not have begin and end dates of hire, documentation showing how the employee meets the minimum age and education qualifications.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Supervised: Director has neglected  her time spent at the center supervising the staff. The staff files need immediate attention as do the administration sub chapter. The staff files were lacking personnel form, affidavit, a statement signed and dated for receiving operational and personnel policies and orientation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Supervised (26 TAC §746.1003(4))
